gen-gf-bruno-ace-instrument-sans: Ruler-straight and unhurried, Bruno Ace lets every character take its own beat. Instrument Sans, a plain sans with a lower, modest lowercase, follows without competing, keeping its strokes uniform beneath the heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-inter: Bruno Ace draws its lines like they were ruled, with counters that stay open to the outside and a slow, one-character-per-beat rhythm. Inter's tall lowercase and smooth sans-serif tubes meet it with real contrast.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-mulish: Constant-width, ruler-drawn lines give Bruno Ace its unmistakable look, each letter held apart and unhurried. Mulish brings a large x-height and short ascenders, a plain sans that stays out of the way.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-poppins: Bruno Ace lingers, one character per beat, on lines that look ruled. Its job is showy presence, while Poppins, a sans-serif with tall sturdy lowercase and loose, unfussy curves, handles the quiet work of being read.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-roboto-slab: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace draws thin-looking strokes that never actually thin out, with counters left open to the outside. Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with a dense middle zone and open throats, brings the structure and precision that Bruno Ace skips.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-rubik: Rubik's lowercase looks big beside its capitals, soft and clear. Over a long passage its open round letters would feel gentle and easy to follow, a sans that lets Bruno Ace's lingering, ruler-drawn heading do the showing off.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-bitter: Beads on a long thread: that is how Bruno Ace SC spaces its smooth, tube-like letters. And Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, grounds them, so nudge its size up if the text feels small.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-instrument-sans: Expressive and wide-spaced, Bruno Ace SC strings its open, unthinning letters out like beads on a thread. Instrument Sans, a plain sans with uniform strokes and a low step from capitals, tightens things up below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-inter: Wide, open and bead-strung, Bruno Ace SC makes an immediate impression with no thinning anywhere in its letters. A long passage in Inter, with its big counters and tall lowercase, would read smooth and untiring in this sans.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-mulish: Bruno Ace SC spreads its open-aperture letters wide, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere, against Mulish's large x-height and horseshoe-open curves. Giving Mulish a slightly generous size helps that plain sans hold its own.
